u: A war drum, painted in three stripes. Hit it and the whole hall goes red, for a moment.
d: A dummy for practising the Fury on. It's seen things.
1: The way out, to the drill yard.

objects.name: Fury-mistress Hagga
lines: DRUM! CHANT! GO RED! Feel it in your teeth!
Every Kaldari goes red before a fight. Since the wastes. Since before kings.

answer: The Fury. Drum till your blood's louder than your fear. Then fight.
My gran said in the wastes it kept you warm. Here it keeps you… loud.

objects.name: Tolly the Cold-Blooded
lines: Three years I've been coming. I can't go red. I just go… a sort of pink.
Hagga says I'm cold-blooded. I think I'm just calm. Somebody has to be.

answer: The drums are nice. And everybody's so cross. Somebody ought to bring biscuits.
Between us, I don't think the old kingdom went red. My nan has a cup with an open hand on it. She hides it.

objects.name: Drummer
lines: Again! From the top! There's no top. It's just BOOM.

objects.name: Drummer
lines: BOOM. …Is Tolly pink again? He's pink again.
